arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactions WHERE date >= '2019-01-01' AND date < '2019-02-01'
arguments.explanation: Counts all transactions dated in January 2019.
assumptions: January 2019 is 2019-01-01 up to but not including 2019-02-01, covering all transactions regardless of label status or error status.
The count includes every transaction row, including those with negative amounts and those without a fraud label.
